nodes.description: Biallelic hypomorphic FARS2 variants reduce the catalytic activity of mtPheRS. p.Asp142Tyr disrupts both steps of the aminoacylation reaction (phenylalanine activation and transfer to tRNA(Phe)), and p.Pro136His retains partial activity. Compared with the variants that cause the infantile epileptic phenotype, the spastic paraplegia variants retain some protein stability and refolding capacity, which is the best available molecular correlate of the milder phenotype. This node substitutes a mitochondrial translation lesion into the mitochondrial-function category of the corticospinal axonopathy trigger.
